messages:
Maria P (partnerships): Hey @Sam H — following up from Thu's sync. Ready to kick off the joint "nominal profile" sweep on your board. Goal: measure perf/W, steady-state throughput, and kernel tuning effects across two model configs. Can you confirm telemetry hooks and a preferred run window? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sam H (partner-hw): Maria — we can expose board-level power (PMBus), host cpu temps, and kernel debug logs. Wed 12:00-16:00 UTC works for us. Which model artifacts do you want? We have 7B_fp16 and 13B_int8 on SDK v2.1 and the older v1.9 builds.
Maria P (partnerships): Use 13B_int8 as primary and 7B_fp16 as baseline. We'll include a quantized 13B_int4 as an extra check. Primary metrics: watts (board), tokens/sec, p99 latency, cycles/token. Perf/W will be tokens/sec divided by average watts over the run. We'll share the prompt set and eval harness.
Dan L (perf-eng): +1. Quick kernel knobs to test: attn_opt=true, kv_cache_prefetch=false, prefetch_pages=4. Please run powercaps at 250W and 200W. Minimal runbook snippet below so infra can wire up automation:
```yaml
run_name: redwood-partner-nominal
models:
  - name: 13B_int8
    seq_len: 2048
    profiles: [throughput, perf-w]
  - name: 7B_fp16
    seq_len: 2048
    profiles: [baseline]
kernel_flags:
  attn_opt: true
  kv_cache_prefetch: false
  prefetch_pages: 4
power_caps: [250, 200]
sweeps:
  - batch_sizes: [1, 8, 32, 64]
  - threads: [1, 2, 4]
logging:
  telemetry_ns: "hw.partner.nominal"
```
Sam H (partner-hw): OK. We'll map sensors to telemetry namespace: hw.power.board, hw.host.cpu.temp, kernel.attn.latency. I'll attach mapping JSON and the vendor daemon notes for ipmi/powercap. Also confirm: voltage control is limited — powercap will be applied via vendor daemon + ipmi.
Maria P (partnerships): I uploaded the prompt set and eval harness: https://redwood-internal/samples/bench/nominal-set. Sam — please confirm you can pull that during the run.
Sam H (partner-hw): Confirmed, we can pull the set. I'll also capture dmesg and kernel debug logs to the run dir. Queueing run for Wed slot.
benchbot: run scheduled by Sam H for 1769997790 — starting 2026-06-08T12:05Z. Results will be collected to /mnt/bench-results/1769997790. :robot_face:
Kevin M (field-eng): Heads-up: add an automatic fallback rule — if throughput drops >15% vs baseline for two consecutive samples, flip attn_opt=false and rerun the mid-size batch. That prevents long tail regressions during partner demos.
Maria P (partnerships): Good call. Action items: Sam -> sensor mapping + vendor notes (Sam H), Dan -> push full runbook and exact git commit for models (Dan L), Kevin -> add fallback rule to the orchestration policy (Kevin M). I'll compile joint PR for marketplace docs after we validate results. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
